steps.name: Given User navigate to the Infoez Login page
When User is on the Login page, they click the Create One link and are navigated to the Registration page.
And User selects the Customer radio button
And User enter name "" in full name field
And User enter email "thasif26@gmail.com" in email field
And User enter phone number "9876543210" in phone number field
And User enter password "admin1" in password field
And User click on create account button
Then User should see the "Name HTML Warning"
